integrity: Original all-order proof and reproducible finite consistency checks; not independently verified. Classical Euler polynomial identities are not claimed as novel.
scientific_limitations: Punctured unit disk, integer logarithmic order q>=1, t>-1; no claims for arbitrary radial weights or noninteger log exponents. Zero count is for attainable off-diagonal scalar products, not pair multiplicities.
title: Exact zero-fibre and parameter-regularity phase diagram for logarithmically weighted punctured disks
